bma.title: BMAcloud sync
bma.hint: The object list is pulled read-only from BMAcloud. A sync overwrites name and address of externally maintained objects; notes, contact data and QR codes stay local. Objects missing from the pull are deactivated, never deleted.
bma.sessionNotice: The BMAcloud sync needs a valid sign-in.
bma.forbiddenNotice: No permission for the BMAcloud sync.
bma.noConflicts: The last sync had no conflicts.
bma.scheduleHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Without a stored value the environment BMA_SYNC_ENABLED / BMA_SYNC_CRON applies.
bma.credentialsHint: The key is only written and never returned. Without a stored value the environment BMA_API_KEY applies.
bma.credentialsSourceDb: The API key is stored in this installation.
bma.credentialsSourceEnv: The API key comes from the environment (BMA_API_KEY).
bma.credentialsSourceNone: No API key is set – the sync cannot run.

errors.bma_not_configured: BMAcloud is not configured – no API key is set. Please enter it in the “BMAcloud API key” field.
